description: Installation of a 20m monopole, 12 antenna apertures, equipment cabinets, the removal of the existing 11.85m monopole, 3 antennas, redundant equipment cabinets and development ancillary thereto
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (5G and Health Mobile UK Report, MBNL 5G and Future Technology - Delivering the UK's Telecoms Future, BEACONCOMMS Statement, BEACONCOMMS Supplementary Information, BEACONCOMMS Cover Letter, Department for Digital, Culture, Media & Sport Statement, Department for Digital, Culture, Media & Sport Connected Growth Report, Councils & Connectivity: How local government can help to build mobile Britain Report, Department for Digital, Culture, Media & Sport 5G - The Next Mobile Generation Statement: Received 23/12/2019.  
985901_HSW011_50670_TW0158_M002 Rev B, 985901_HSW011_50670_TW0158_M002 Rev B, 985901_HSW011_50670_TW0158_M002 Rev B, 985901_HSW011_50670_TW0158_M002 Rev B, 985901_HSW011_50670_TW0158_M002 Rev B: Received 05/02/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The structure, antenna, and associated facilities will be removed if they become obsolete.

Condition : 4 - Temporary obstructions during installation of the hereby approved development shall not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic, all vehicles associated with the installation must only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions, the width of the footway and carriageway of the A4 Great West Road must not be reduced or blocked providing a clear passage for pedestrians and cyclists at any time and access to the nearby bus stop must be maintained at all times.
